headline: TSMC tightens restrictions on AI chips for China after new EU rules
summary: TSMC is tightening restrictions on AI chips it supplies for China, following new EU rules. The move could close one of the last routes available to Chinese firms seeking powerful AI processors.
why: TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker and a key supplier of advanced AI processors. Export restrictions on its output affect AI hardware demand and Chinese chip design firms.
original_headline: TSMC endurece restricciones sobre chips de IA para China tras nuevas normas de EU
